effect-authority.scope: Effect admission, authority, settlement and verification

session-lifecycle.scope: Conversation and run lifecycle; never effect authority

tool-policy.scope: Tool registry, policy decision and enforcement point

conversation-ir.scope: Provider-neutral model messages, turns, wire codecs and bounded framing

local-transport-contracts.scope: Versioned local submit, steer, interrupt and event frames with bounded fail-closed decoding

asserts: Tauri payload contains engine and Rust kernel from this tree
compiled engine is built from the composition root
owned composition uses the durable session runtime and enforced tool registry
serve protocol state survives SQLite reopen and imports retired JSONL rows exactly once
harness uses generated Rust contracts and owned profiles
Rust contracts, authority, journal and host gates pass
bound reads return only a Rust-verified digest and fail closed on unknown outcomes
LSP failures remain unavailable rather than inferred
provider families encode and decode through one neutral IR
stream framing fails closed at its byte ceiling
legacy source remains read-only and import is verified
owned harness profiles parse and apply deterministically
catalog is local and remote providers require owner configuration
unknown outcomes are never blindly replayed
duplicate refusal and digest stability tests pass
atomicity, redaction and process-tree tests pass
script remains an explicitly planned orphan until R5 supplies a runnable adapter proof
opaque reference and lease tests pass
every run lands a terminal event
policy denial, approval, timeout and rollback tests pass
current shell frames reject malformed fields
versioned local frames reject unknown fields, trailing bytes and oversized declarations

asserts: unavailable is never accepted as pass
web surface builds without an external runtime dependency
isolation is enforced or refused without downgrade
